Outcome.DescriptionText: The Portal is gone, and its wreckage is scattered across the system. Our salvage crews report a wealth of interesting finds: torn hull lattices, reactor cores, drone shells and fragments of technology we have never seen. Best of all, they have recovered a fully intact Remnant mainframe. Our scientists are beside themselves. \n \n A salvage project will let us recover the ancient armour and build a research complex around the mainframe. Once the complex is powered, its records promise to reveal how the Remnant built their ships, from the smallest drone up to the Portal itself.
Outcome.ConfirmText: Get the mainframe to the labs!
